title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E8 — Jealousy
Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E9 — Tooth Or Consequences
When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E11 — The Puerto Ricans Are Coming! The Puerto Ricans Are Coming!
Fred is upset because his new neighbor is opening a competing junkyard -- but he's beside himself when he learns the neighbor is Puerto Rican. Fred vows to remedy the situation, over the strong objections of Lamont, who has become Julio's friend.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E9 — The Last Leaf
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E10 — Louise's New Interest
Is Louise going away on a weekend Indian 'dig' because of her interest in archeology or in the handsome archeologist? And that's exactly what George and Helen want to know.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E11 — Costume Party, The
George's cleaning business may be cleaned up for good when he resorts to playing a dirty trick in order to secure the business of a large costume company.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E5 — George Carlin, Pat Boone & Family, Sugar Ray Robinson
Flip sells ice cream; Flip & Carlin do a TV news spoof; Boone intros his family and the cast does a "To Tell A Lie" panel show sketch.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E6 — The Supremes, Willie Tyler & Lester, David Frost
Flip plays a huckster; the Supremes join Flip & Frost for a secret agent and haunted castle skits; Willie Tyler does ventriloquism.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E7 — The Smothers Brothers, Melba Moore
Flips intros his invisible dog; a traveling salesman hits on Melba in the old days and the Smothers Bros join Rev. Leroy’s church.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E9 — Dom DeLuise, Diahann Carroll, Kermit The Frog, The Muppets
Flip jokes about ugly fans; Diahann kisses Kermit; a drunk muppet has hiccups and Diahann stops by Flip’s gas station.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E9 — Morgan/Silver/Humphrey
An all jazz line-up on this edition of Soul! features pianist Horace Silver at the electric keyboard, Lee Morgan on trumpet and 22-year old Bobbi Humphrey playing the flute. They are joined by vocalists Andy and Salome Bey.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E10 — Gladys Knight and the Pips
One of the great Motown acts of the past several years headlines the show, performing the hit, "I Heard It through the Grapevine.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E10 — A Question of Honor
All the blame goes to Webster when his friends try to rob the Tracadero, their hangout.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E12 — Educating Katherine
Katherine gets a taste of the worst: being a volunteer art teacher. She feels that she is boring and failing, so Webster tries to help her.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E13 — Teddy Bear Scare
George and Katherine both try and persuade Webster that he can do without his teddy bear, which is lost.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E14 — George, The Patient in Spite of Himself
Webster has to have his tonsils out, so he tries to be tough just like George.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E17 — Secrets of The Night
Webster is always nervous and it's resulted with him having a bed-wetting problem.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E17 — Double Talk
Jordan's guest shot on Tamera's radio show turns into a full-time gig, but it may cost them their friendship.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E18 — FreakNik
Tia, Tamera, and Diavian all go to FreakNik in Atlanta during Spring Break. Tyreke races to Atlanta hoping to make up with Tia, but it may not be in time to save their relationship.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E19 — Before There Was Hip-Hop
An old-time jazz legend fuels dreams of the swing era for the class and dreams of heroics for Jordan.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E20 — Let Them Eat Cupcake
A series of mix-ups delays Victor's marriage proposal to Lisa.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E21 — The Road Less Traveled
Tia considers taking a summer internship with the WNBA in New York. Meanwhile, Lisa worries about her upcoming wedding.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E6 — The Play Scene
Mo writes a scene from a play set in a Blues Lounge in the 1940s for her English class, and our cast acts it out for us.
